item.stem:
The diagram shows trapezium $ABCD$ with $AB\parallel DC$. Angle $DAB=70^\circ$. Imran wants angle $ADC$ on the same non-parallel side as angle $DAB$.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: Angle $ADC=70^\circ$ because angle $ADC$ must equal angle $DAB$ in a trapezium.
options.B: Angle $ADC$ cannot be found from the parallel sides alone.
options.C: Angle $ADC=110^\circ$ because the angles on the same non-parallel side between the parallel sides add to $180^\circ$.
options.D: Angle $ADC=70^\circ$ because $AB$ equals $DC$ on the diagram.
